currentParagraphText: “It’s kits... Fortuna Ferret kits...” she said, those words enough to convince her partner.

finalResult.nextParagraphText: “Can they be moved? What do you need me to do?”
finalResult.previousParagraphText: At least they had been protected... but now their mother was gone, whisked away by wind magic. Keerla had to make a decision fast as she reached out to Solana through their paired rings that allowed communication – a quite lovely wedding gift from Keerla’s parents back in the day.
